applicableAreas: Site-wide construction activities near transmission facilities
findings.comment: Plans reference electric transmission facilities and note requirement for 48-hour pre-construction safety meeting with Austin Energy (Sheet 3 Block 20, note #3), providing contact Andrew Perez, 512-505-7153. No documentation provided that this meeting has been scheduled or completed before construction commencement.

Grading plan indicates excavation activities, but construction sequence notes do not explicitly document that One Call (1-800-344-8377) will be contacted prior to digging to locate and mark existing underground electric facilities, despite presence of Texas 811 logo on sheet.

applicableAreas: Areas within 25 feet of transmission structures
findings.comment: Sheet 3 Block 20 note #2 prohibits digging or grading within 25 feet of transmission structures and requires prior coordination with Austin Energy. Grading plan does not show transmission structure locations, 25-foot evaluation zones, or documentation of Austin Energy evaluation and approval for any grading within these zones.

applicableAreas: Excavation sites within 25 feet of transmission structures
findings.comment: Grading plan shows building pads and site excavation but does not identify depths of excavation relative to transmission structures or document Austin Energy evaluation for excavations exceeding 1 foot within 25-foot radius.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1, 7, and 8 proximity to overhead electric lines; detention pond area
findings.comment: Site plan shows buildings located in proximity to overhead electric facilities (OHE lines) along southern and western boundaries. No NESC Section 234 clearance calculations or documentation provided. Transmission conductor locations not dimensioned on plans; clearance verification cannot be confirmed.

Building finished floor elevations and FFE data shown but vertical excavation depths adjacent to transmission lines are not dimensioned on foundation plans. No documentation of submission to Austin Energy for evaluation of foundation depths near transmission structures.

applicableAreas: Irrigation system installation areas, particularly along southern and eastern property boundaries
findings.comment: Landscape plan references an irrigation system per irrigation notes but does not show specific sprinkler head locations. Sheet 3 Block 20 note #14 prohibits sprinklers within 25 feet of transmission poles and structures. Compliance with this clearance cannot be verified from submitted plans.

Fire protection plan shows fire hydrant location, but transmission structure locations are not clearly dimensioned on plans. The required 20-foot minimum distance from transmission structures cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Detention and biofiltration pond in northeast corner of site
findings.comment: Detention and biofiltration pond shown in northeast corner. Sheet 3 Block 20 note #16 prohibits detention ponds in transmission easement or where they would impair access. Transmission easement boundaries and 100-foot working area are not clearly depicted on plans; relationship between pond and transmission infrastructure cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1, 7, 8; driveways; overall site layout relative to transmission structures
findings.comment: Sheet 3 Block 20 note #8 requires 24-hour access to electric facilities. The 25-foot access corridor and 100-foot working area for Condor truck turnaround (80,000 lb vehicles) are not drawn on site plan. Transmission structure locations not clearly identified; whether permanent site features encroach on required clearance and turnaround space cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Utility pole guy wire and guy anchor locations
findings.comment: Existing conditions survey (Sheet 4) shows utility poles with guy wire symbols at property corners, but site plan does not depict guy anchor locations or dimensions. Required clearances from guy wires and guy anchors cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Existing overhead electric lines and utilities on or adjacent to property
findings.comment: Existing overhead electric facilities (OHE lines) shown on property boundaries and in adjacent ROW. No documentation provided showing whether these facilities conflict with proposed improvements or whether cost assignment for relocation has been determined and documented in site plans or utility agreements.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary where overhead electric line runs adjacent to landscaping; approximately 10 tree locations along southern and eastern boundaries
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows approximately 10 trees planted directly adjacent to or immediately under the overhead electric (OHE) line along the southern property boundary. Sheet 3 Block 20 note #1 prohibits tree planting within 25 feet of transmission structure base. No documentation provided that these tree species are utility-compatible (marked 'UC' in ECM Appendix F) or that mature heights are restricted to ≤20 feet.

applicableAreas: Driveways and roads crossing 5-foot electric easements on eastern, western, and southern property boundaries
findings.comment: Site plan shows driveways and access roads crossing electric easements. Sheet 3 Block 20 note #12 requires roads/driveways in transmission easement to support 46,000 lb. tandem axle (5-foot spacing). Pavement design sheets do not document load-bearing capacity calculations or certification for transmission maintenance vehicle loading.

applicableAreas: Building foundations and structures relative to underground electric service lines
findings.comment: Electrical service plan shows underground electric routing but does not include dimensional verification of 60-inch (5-foot) minimum horizontal clearance from customer building foundations and permanent structures.

applicableAreas: Underground electric service routing relative to buildings and structures
findings.comment: Electrical service plan shows underground electric routing but does not verify that no buildings, foundations, or permanent structures are positioned over underground conduit, duct bank, or cable routes.
